extracted.name: Lazy Golumpki (Stuffed Cabbage) Soup
extracted.description: This lazy golumpki soup is a Polish soup of simmered cabbage and ground beef. It's like stuffed cabbage, but it's in soup form — with a lot less work!
ingredient_lines: 1 head cabbage, cut into bite-size pieces
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until translucent, 5 to 10 minutes. Add ground beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes.
Transfer beef mixture to a slow cooker. Stir in water, cabbage, tomato purée, condensed soup, rice, bouillon, salt, and pepper. Cover and cook on High for 8 hours.
